description: Wire contract for the VCF Operations report-generation workflow. Every field under 'operations' is derived from the VCF Operations OpenAPI document identified in docs/official_sources.json. The 'wire' and 'asyncPolling' sections state the calling rules this deployment enforces; they constrain how the operations below are invoked but do not add operations.

wire.authorizationHeaderNotes: The specification declares only the header name (Authorization) for the Token-based-authorization apiKey scheme. This deployment requires the VCF 9.x scheme prefix 'OpsToken' followed by a single space and the token returned by acquireToken. Requests to operations that inherit globalSecurity are rejected with HTTP 401 when the header is absent or does not use this prefix.
wire.omitUnsetOptionalFieldsNotes: An optional request-body property or optional query parameter that the caller has not set MUST be absent from the request entirely. Sending the key with null, an empty string, or an empty array is a contract violation and is rejected with HTTP 400. Explicit falsy values that the caller did set (for example publish=false) are legal and MUST be sent.
wire.requestBodyOnlyWhenSchemaDefined: An operation with no requestBody in the specification MUST be sent with no body at all - no Content-Type and no '{}' payload.

asyncPolling.description: createReport starts report generation and returns immediately; the returned report is not finished. The caller MUST poll getReport with the returned identifier until the report reaches a terminal status. Treating the createReport response, or any single getReport response, as proof of completion is a contract violation.
asyncPolling.unknownStatusHandling: Any status value not listed in terminalStatuses is non-terminal; continue polling until the caller's poll timeout elapses.
asyncPolling.downloadPrecondition: downloadReport MUST NOT be called until getReport has returned COMPLETED for that report identifier. Calling it earlier is rejected with HTTP 409. It MUST NOT be called at all for a report that reached FAILED.
asyncPolling.statusNotes: The specification types report.status as a free-form string and does not enumerate its values. The values listed here are the ones this deployment emits.

acquireToken.summary: Acquire a token to perform REST API calls
acquireToken.securityNotes: Declares an empty security array in the specification, so no Authorization header is sent for this call.

200.description: The token and expiry time of the token

createReport.summary: Generate (create) a Report using the specified Report Definition and for the specified Resource

requestBody.serverAssignedPropertiesNotes: The 'report' schema is shared between this request body and the responses of createReport/getReport. The properties listed in serverAssignedProperties are populated by the server on the way out and MUST NOT be sent on the way in; sending one is rejected with HTTP 400. 'traversalSpec' is accepted by the API but is out of scope for this workflow and MUST NOT be sent.

getReport.summary: Get the detail of a Report given its identifier

downloadReport.summary: Download the Report given its identifier
downloadReport.formatNotes: Quoting the specification: 'The supported formats for Reports are PDF, CSV. If the format is not specified the downloaded report will be in PDF format. NOTE: In case the Accept header is provided, ensure that its value corresponds to the format request parameter (including the default value when the request parameter is omitted).' The Accept header is therefore required to match the effective format; a mismatch is rejected with HTTP 406. When the caller does not choose a format the 'format' query parameter MUST be absent from the request URI and the Accept header MUST be application/pdf.

200.description: The link to download the report

releaseToken.requestBodyNotes: The specification defines no requestBody for this operation, so the request MUST carry no body and no Content-Type header.
